name: volume_momentum_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus
thesis: Volume-weighted momentum measures not just how much price moved, but how much volume participated in the move. When ROC(10) is positive AND cumulative volume on up-bars exceeds cumulative volume on down-bars by >60:40 over the last 20 bars, the momentum has institutional backing (large volume confirming the direction). Moves on thin volume tend to reverse; moves on heavy volume tend to continue. The edge exists because most momentum indicators ignore volume entirely (RSI, MACD, ROC are all price-only). Integrating volume into momentum scoring provides a more informative signal. The inefficiency persists because volume-weighted momentum is not a standard indicator in any major charting platform — it requires custom computation.
mechanism: Institutional order flow arrives in bursts via algorithmic execution (TWAP/VWAP slicing), creating persistent directional pressure over 30-120 seconds. Retail and smaller participants follow the initial move, extending momentum before liquidity absorbs the flow and the order book rebalances.

exit.signal_exit: exit if vol_ratio_20 reverts to 0.45-0.55 range (volume participation neutralized)

filters.volume_filter: integrated into the signal — vol_ratio_20 IS the volume filter

weaknesses: The up/down volume classification (close > open) is crude — a bar can close green on low volume and red on high volume
20-bar lookback means the volume ratio can be distorted by a single extreme-volume bar
In low-volume periods (lunch hour 12:30-13:30), the ratio is based on thin data and unreliable
prior_art: Volume Price Trend (VPT), On-Balance Volume (OBV), and Chaikin Money Flow all attempt to integrate volume with price direction. The specific up_vol / total_vol ratio over 20 bars is a simplified version of Volume Weighted Average Price's directional component. Easley et al. (2012) VPIN is related but uses a different bucketing approach.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
